chunks: And from him, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: concerning
a free man who killed a slave, he said: “He is not killed for him.”

key_terms.حُرٍّ: a free person, legally distinguished from a slave
key_terms.عَبْدًا: a slave; the victim in this ruling
key_terms.لَا يُقْتَلُ بِهِ: he is not executed in retaliation for him

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a free man kills a slave in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding retaliation in cases of homicide involving a free man and a slave. It states that a free man is not subject to qisas execution for killing a slave, reflecting a juristic distinction discussed in the chapters of legal retribution.
